audit.why: On disk the chart reads Skill, Singed, Singed, Skill, Skill, Singed, Singed — no Cho'Gath stage at all on a lane Singed wins 54.49% over 758 games, which is defensible, and the level-3 and level-6 rows are marked Skill rather than his, which fits whys[2] and whys[4] warning about the silence combo and Feast. No mirror file exists for this pair. Note: the levelChart in tools/audit-run/packets/singed.json is a different, older chart and does not match disk.

audit.whatIsWrong: Not one cooldown number appears, and the level-6 spike invents a threshold: 'one botched all-in where you drop below roughly 35% HP is a free kill'.
audit.why: Feast is 80s at rank 1 and Riot's text calls it 'a high amount of true damage' with no stated execute threshold — a made-up percentage tells the reader to fight at 40% when they should not. Feral Scream is 11s, Rupture 6s, Vorpal Spikes 8s. Rupture's 6s is the reason 'wait for his Q' is not a plan: you sidestep it instead.
audit.corrected: 80s Feast, 11s Feral Scream and 6s Rupture written into the cooldown row, spikes, whys and mid; the invented 35% threshold removed.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Mega Adhesive root into Fling' and 'Root Cho'Gath with Mega Adhesive' appear three times — the adhesive slows and grounds, and the root only happens when Fling lands him inside it. Separately, Carnivore is never mentioned, so the reader never learns that Insanity Potion's Grievous Wounds cuts the health he restores off every kill.
audit.why: Riot text — Singed W: 'slowing and grounding enemies who walk on it'. Singed E: 'If the target Singed flings lands in his Mega Adhesive, they are also rooted.' Singed R: 'making his Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds'. Cho'Gath P: 'Whenever Cho'Gath kills a unit, he recovers Health and Mana.' The one thing Singed's glue does NOT do here is disable mobility — Cho'Gath has no dash for the grounding to take.
audit.corrected: Correct root sequencing everywhere, plus the Grievous Wounds line against Carnivore.

audit.whatIsWrong: The cooldown row tracked Feast and nothing else, and called your own abilities 'your committal tool' and 'your ultimate'.
audit.why: Feral Scream at 11s is the punishing cooldown in this lane, because a silenced Singed can cast neither Fling nor Mega Adhesive — that is the window he kills you in, not Feast.
audit.corrected: Named with the number in the cooldown row, report[5], phases[2].why and wants.you[2].

edits.before: Levels 4 and 5 are your proxy window: Cho'Gath cannot sprint after you, cannot silence you from outside his W range, and his Q is too telegraphed to reliably land on a moving Singed — run behind his wave, stack Poison Trail on the casters, and bank gold while he is trapped deciding whether to follow or farm. At level 6 the calculus shifts hard in his favour: Feast requires no wind-up and deals true damage that ignores your tankiness entirely, so one botched all-in where you drop below roughly 35% HP is a free kill for him regardless of Insanity Potion's armor and MR. Use your level 6 ult to Ghost-proxy aggressively rather than to duel him directly — force him to burn Teleport or cede the wave, not to fight you in his Q range.
edits.after: Levels 4 and 5 are your proxy window: Cho'Gath cannot sprint after you, cannot silence you from outside Feral Scream's range, and Rupture is too telegraphed to land on a moving Singed — run behind his wave, stack Poison Trail on the casters, and bank gold while he decides between following and farming. At level 6 the calculus shifts in his favour: Feast (80s) is flat true damage that ignores every point of resistance Insanity Potion gives you, so a botched all-in at low health is a free kill for him no matter how tanky the bar looks. What your ultimate does buy you is Grievous Wounds on Poison Trail, halving the Carnivore health he restores off every minion. Use 6 to Ghost-proxy rather than to duel — force him to burn Teleport or cede the wave, never to fight you inside Rupture range.

notes: Removed the invented 'below roughly 35% HP' execute threshold on Feast — Riot's text gives no threshold, only 'a high amount of true damage', and a made-up number tells the reader a health bar is safe when it is not. Also removed the 'Mega Adhesive root' phrasing in three places; the root requires a Fling to land him in the goo. Added the missing anti-heal line: Carnivore restores health on every unit kill and Insanity Potion's Grievous Wounds halves it. Note that Singed's glue does nothing mobility-wise here — Cho'Gath has no dash — so I did not sell the grounding in this matchup. champ-data/_kits/chogath.json flags Rupture as grounding; Riot's description says only knock-up and slow, so I did not assert it. The levelChart field in the packet for this matchup does not match what is on disk — treat that snapshot as stale.
